description: Postos de Abastecimento de Combustíveis para Veículos Rodoviários is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Direção-Geral de Energia e Geologia - DGEG. Fuel supply stations located on the mainland of Portugal, for public and cooperative consumption, whose responsibility for compliance lies with the holders of the respective operating licences (holder). Coverage: Direção-Geral de Energia e Geologia - DGEG. The portal shows the English title as "Fuel Supply Stations for Road Vehicles" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Direção-Geral de Energia e Geologia - DGEG. Its keywords include planeamento-e-cadastro, infofeatureaccessservice, hvd, snig-dgterritorio-gov-pt, ambiente, cartografia-oficial. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
